tldr: Mars through the 2nd house heats up money, security, values, and self-worth.
body:
When Mars moves through your 2nd house, it adds heat and urgency to money, security, possessions, self-worth, spending, income, and what helps you feel steady. You may notice what feels worth keeping, what costs too much, and what would help life feel more stable.

You may feel more impatient, motivated, protective, desirous, or ready to act. It can help you move something that has been stuck.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for making a more honest choice around resources, desire, and value.

The caution: Watch for reacting before you know what you are actually trying to change. The risk is confusing immediate comfort with real security.

Mars moves through this house for about six weeks. Give the pressure a useful outlet. Act with a target, not just a charge.
